rationale: The replication successfully reproduces all four headline sub-claims: ferro-octupolar ground state (uniform S≈(0.5,0,0)), transition temperature To=1.5|Jx| derived analytically from mean-field theory, non-divergent χzz confirming hidden order, and gapped octupolar wave excitation. The phase slice on the Ix surface shows 43/49 points as FO, consistent with the paper. Coverage is reduced because the full self-consistent 3-sublattice phase diagram (Fig. 2) and quantum dipole-octupole modulation effects were not reproduced, and SI coupling definitions were unavailable. Agreement is high as all quantitative checks match exactly or qualitatively.
